# scutum_webhook (Resource)

Configure a Scutum webhook endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scutum_webhook" "pagerduty" {
  name   = "PagerDuty alerts"
  url    = "https://events.pagerduty.com/integration/abc123/enqueue"
  secret = var.webhook_secret
  events = [
    "alert.fired",
    "alert.resolved",
    "node.offline",
  ]
}

variable "webhook_secret" {
  description = "HMAC signing secret for the PagerDuty webhook"
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (List of String) Event types to subscribe to (e.g. node.enrolled, alert.fired).
- `name` (String)
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL to deliver events to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC-SHA256 signing secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
